== 📜 Patch Notes - Apr 9, 2026 ==

* On spawn, '''Kraken''' will have a 5 minute buff: [Kraken's Mucus]

* [Kraken's Mucus]
** Duration: 5 minutes
** Reduces received damage by 100%, gradually fading to 0% once the buff expires.
** Does '''NOT''' apply to '''Primal''' Kraken
* [Daru Blessing] ("daru sub") buff is now '''HIDDEN''' and will not count towards buff slots.

* The marketplace window will now display your ongoing subscription timer under the player preview
* [Egg Basket Teleport Scroll] now properly benefits from [Daru Blessing] -50% cast time
